source_snapshot.items: AC Power Cycle System Sequence Check
source_snapshot.procedure: Baseline, S5, smart-PDU all mapped PSU feeds off, full drain, feeds on, IPMI power on, Post-Boot Stress/Basic Health/dmesg/RAS, repeat 100 cycles.
source_snapshot.criteria: Power-cycle completion, 100 recommended, no lock/MCE/kernel error/health mismatch/Post-Boot failure.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; physical AC action is human-only.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL; operator, feed mapping, drain proof and complete cycle evidence required.

old_problem: Exact PDU-to-PSU mapping, drain proof, timings, readiness, criteria and recovery were absent; logs were cleared and plaintext IPMI shown. Historical review also treated 100 as unresolved despite the Procedure explicitly commanding 100 repetitions.
disposition_reason: The AC transition is explicit and the Procedure requires 100 cycles; ED-14 preserves that formal count, so `recommended` cannot authorize a short run. Under ED-09 the trained operator owns mains switching, while feed mapping, drain/timing thresholds, recipes and recovery are signed Project Configuration rather than Engineering Decision Pending. Full power, boot and health evidence is mandatory for every cycle.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2069, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2070 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00114-V003 / 2059d77b07fe583f was directly read from XLSX and locked queue.
The Procedure unambiguously defines full AC removal through smart-PDU feeds, drain, restoration and host power-on; this is not S5-only or DC-only coverage.
`Repeat ... for 100 cycles` is the executable source requirement; ED-14 forbids replacing it with a shorter smoke run despite Criteria wording.
All PSU feeds, outlet identities, off/drain/on proof and timing are exact-platform runtime bindings; they do not require inventing the test purpose or pass logic.
Physical mains work remains manual-only; protected automation may observe and collect evidence but never toggle the PDU.
No shutdown, PDU/AC, IPMI, health test, log clear, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Manual 100-cycle full-AC off/drain/on sequence with per-cycle boot and health proof
test_case.purpose: Have a trained operator complete exactly 100 full AC removals and restores across every mapped PSU feed, proving drain, ordered recovery, unique healthy boots, passing Post-Boot Stress/Basic Health and no new lock/MCE/RAS/kernel/BMC fault.
required_package: Exact SUT/PSU-feed-to-PDU-outlet map and independent electrical/off/drain/on state oracle
Approved off/drain/on timing, PDU event semantics and trained operator authorization
Boot media, unique boot-ID/OS/service/GPU readiness and timeout rules
Exact Basic Health/Post-Boot recipes and full error comparison policy
Workload/data drain, immutable 1-100 ledger, console/OOB recovery and final-state contract
test_case.test_command: MANUAL ONLY — agent must not control AC. Preserve baseline; for cycles 1-100, the trained operator places the SUT in the approved pre-off state, switches every mapped feed off, proves full AC-off/drain, restores feeds in the approved order and performs the approved host-on action. Protected automation correlates PDU/electrical events, unique boot/readiness, exact stress/health and complete error deltas, sealing each cycle before the next. Stop on first anomaly; no clear, shortcut or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 100 cycles independently prove every intended feed off, approved drain, ordered restore, unique OS-ready boot, complete GPU/service readiness, passing health/stress and zero disallowed error or lock.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 100/100 complete AC transitions and every per-cycle oracle. FAIL on unmapped/live feed, incomplete drain/restore/boot, duplicate/skipped cycle, health mismatch, lock/MCE/error or evidence gap. Fewer cycles, PDU response alone or final reachability cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Only a trained authorized operator performs mains switching; automation is evidence-only.
Protect data/workloads and validate recovery plus every feed/outlet before cycle 1.
Stop on electrical ambiguity, PDU/PSU/control loss, boot/health fault or unsafe condition.
Never auto-retry, clear logs, shorten 100 cycles or substitute another cycle class.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, operator authorization and signed feed/outlet/drain/timing map
Baseline boot media, identity, health/stress/RAS/kernel/BMC and recovery check
Immutable cycle 1-100 operator and PDU/electrical off/drain/on records
Per-cycle unique boot/readiness and complete health/stress/error artifacts
100-cycle reconciliation with no gap/duplicate/retry and final restored state
test_case.recovery: On unsafe/ambiguous AC state, controller loss, failed restore/boot or health error, stop and preserve the first-failure cycle. The agent must not toggle outlets or retry. The trained operator uses only the approved electrical/console recovery and obtains owner release.

source_conflict.reason: The Procedure supplies true AC off/drain/on and explicit 100 repetitions; runtime mapping and quantitative state proof remove the remaining safety/evidence gaps without changing coverage.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; execution depends on ordinary Project Configuration and trained manual authorization.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Feed/outlet mapping, drain/timing oracle, operator, recipes, error limits, maintenance, evidence storage and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO MANUAL 100-CYCLE AC TEST; NO SHUTDOWN, PDU/AC, IPMI, HEALTH TEST, LOG CLEAR, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Preserves AC identity, manual physical boundary, all 100 cycles, complete transition proof and no retry.

project_authority: Platform power owner signs mapping/state/timing; trained operator performs AC work; OS/GPU owners approve health recipes and engineer verdict.
